en.html:
At the last possible instant, I threw the cylinder up at the ceiling.
Thanks to that, no burns.

The ceiling, however, acquired a hole.
And something came down through it.


The something had the appearance of a sooty human being. There were two of it.
They closely resembled Captain Ootori and Chamberlain Nagakura.

They were Captain Ootori and Chamberlain Nagakura.

en.html:
Kanae"Fu, fu, fu... A very good morning, Mr. Kageaki."
Sayo"Ho, ho, ho. Mr. Minato, what an exceptionally warm welcome you have prepared."
Sayo"This Sayo may have underestimated you a little. Such a ferocious sense of comedy! You and our young lady are understanding each other on a very deep level."
Kageaki"............"
Kageaki"Why?"
Kanae"We were waiting inside the gasbag. Then came a great noise which appeared to be your attack, so naturally we began to move..."
Sayo"Only, the route by which we entered had been locked. We managed to come down as far as the space above the hull’s ceiling. There we were, considering our next step..."
Kanae"And suddenly something exploded under our feet."
Kageaki"I see."
Sayo"Most fortunately, a large hole opened in the ceiling. Most delightfully, we were able to escape by falling three meters and striking the floor. And most movingly, there stood Mr. Minato, a lit stove beside him, and a very remarkable smell of gas!"
Kanae"One of the super-happiest moments of my life, no? As if the calendar’s blackest day and the Walpurgis had both come at once!"
Kageaki"Is that so. I am glad I could be of service."
Kanae"Yes. So very glad we are♪"

Kageaki"............"

Kageaki"Why?"

Kanae"We were waiting inside the gasbag. Then came a great noise which appeared to be your attack, so naturally we began to move..."

Sayo"Only, the route by which we entered had been locked. We managed to come down as far as the space above the hull’s ceiling. There we were, considering our next step..."

Kanae"And suddenly something exploded under our feet."

Kageaki"I see."

Sayo"Most fortunately, a large hole opened in the ceiling. Most delightfully, we were able to escape by falling three meters and striking the floor. And most movingly, there stood Mr. Minato, a lit stove beside him, and a very remarkable smell of gas!"

Kanae"One of the super-happiest moments of my life, no? As if the calendar’s blackest day and the Walpurgis had both come at once!"

Kageaki"Is that so. I am glad I could be of service."

Kanae"Yes. So very glad we are♪"

ja.html:
香奈枝 「ふ、ふ、ふ……。 　景明さま、ごきげんよう」
さよ 「ほっほっほっ。 　いやー何とも熱烈な歓迎でございますなー 湊斗さま」
さよ 「このさよ、貴方さまのことを少々甘く見て いたのやもしれませぬ。 　まさかこういう、うちのお嬢さまに通じる 酷烈なギャグセンスをお持ちであったとは」
景明 「…………」
景明 「何故なにゆえに？」
香奈枝 「うふふ…… 　気嚢の内側に潜んで待っていたところに、 景明さまの襲撃と思しき轟音が聞こえたので わたくしたちも動き始めたのですが……」
さよ 「潜入に使用した経路が施錠されてしまって おりましてなァ。 　どうにか船体の天井裏までは降りて、さて これから如何にと悩んでいましたところ……」
香奈枝 「突然、足元で爆発が起きて」
景明 「ほう」
さよ 「有難いことに天井板に大穴が開き、嬉しい ことに三メートルも落下して床に激突しつつ 脱出を果たせ、感動的なことにそこには湊斗 さまと火のついたコンロと異様なガス臭が！」
香奈枝 「人生最大級のスーパーハッピータイムよね！ 　まるで仏滅と悪魔祝祭ワルプルギスが一緒に来たみたい」
景明 「そうですか。 　お役に立てたようで何よりです」
香奈枝 「ええ、本当に♪」

en.html:
Chamberlain Nagakura, slightly scorched, laughed.

...Now then.
The swirl of murderous intent was almost becoming a physical wave, tying my legs down. Walking was proving difficult. All the same, we ought to move away quickly.

Enemy soldiers might hear the explosion and come rushing here. In any case, now that we had joined up, I should rely on the Ootori pair’s abilities and search again.
We might discover something new.
Provided I was not shot dead here first.

ja.html:
微妙に焦げた永倉侍従が笑った。

　……さて。
　物理的波動と化しつつある殺意の渦が俺の足を縛る
せいで非常に歩き辛いのだが、今は急いで場所を移る
べきだろう。

　爆音を聞きつけた敵兵がここに殺到して来ないとも
限らない。
　何はともあれ合流を果たせたからには、大鳥主従の
技能を恃んで改めて探索を行うべきでもある。

　新たな発見があるかもしれない。
　とりあえず、今この場で射殺されなければの話では
あるが。
